title: Configure DNS
subtitle: Service discovery, zones, records & troubleshooting
description: Learn how DNS lets every domain member find its domain controllers, then build dependable internal name resolution on DC01 and DC02: set each controller's DNS order, configure forward and reverse zones, manage service records, and prove resolution, discovery and failover in the air-gapped training network.
outcomes: Explain how DNS lets members find domain controllers, and plan internal DNS and client settings.
Configure secure AD-integrated zones and maintain records.
Test both resolvers, directory discovery, and client fallback.
Find a DNS fault one layer at a time and record the cause, the fix, and the rollback.

stages.title: Map names to the network
stages.detail: Domain Name System (DNS) turns names into addresses, and for Active Directory it does one more job: it tells every domain member where its domain controllers are. Start from the working directory build, learn what DNS answers and what it doesn't, set each controller's DNS client order, and record which server owns each name and how a client finds it.

stages.title: Configure forward and reverse zones
stages.detail: A zone holds the records for one part of the namespace. Forward lookup answers where a name lives. Reverse lookup answers which name is assigned to an address. AD integration lets the directory replicate zone data between the selected DNS servers.

stages.title: Create and maintain service records
stages.detail: Build a small, intentional record set. A host record identifies a machine; an alias provides a stable service name without making that alias a separate server.

stages.title: Prove resolution and directory discovery
stages.detail: Test each server explicitly before testing client fallback. A successful cached answer does not prove that both DNS servers hold the right records, and a correct DNS answer proves neither a successful sign-in nor access to a protected resource.

stages.title: Find the fault and record the fix
stages.detail: Troubleshoot one layer at a time: client settings, server reachability, authoritative data, replication, and finally the application that uses the name.

outcomeSummary: Names that resolve from either controller. Discovery that survives one being down. Proven, not assumed.
